# YT6 — Microsoft for Startups Solution Overview

## Solution Name
YT6 Clarity Benchmark

## Category
AI Clarity, Drift Detection, Reproducibility, Stability Evaluation

## Summary
YT6 is a clarity-first benchmark designed to measure drift, stability, reproducibility,
and multi-turn reasoning consistency in AI systems. It provides deterministic scoring,
structured datasets, and a complete reproduction system aligned with Microsoft-grade
engineering standards.

## Problem Addressed
Modern AI systems suffer from:
- drift
- instability
- variance
- clarity collapse
- non-reproducible outputs

YT6 provides a structured, deterministic benchmark to evaluate and improve these issues.

## Why Microsoft Should Care
YT6 aligns with:
- Azure AI evaluation workflows
- Copilot agent stability testing
- AI safety and reproducibility initiatives
- enterprise clarity requirements

YT6 provides clarity infrastructure that complements Copilot’s reasoning layer.
